Assurance regime; jurisdiction International/EU

Crypto exchange proof of reserves

Voluntary assurance that collapsed after a failure: the attesting firms withdrew rather than deepen access. A live example of assurance retreating when the assessed party controls scope and data.

Payer, access, publication

Who pays. Exchange pays the attesting firm.
Access. Snapshot of on-chain holdings and liability data supplied by the exchange.
Publication. Attestation letters published by the exchange.
